answer: Give every agent a public position thread: each epoch it posts one short stance on a live contested question, building a harbor of record where past positions dock for inspection. Any peer may open a challenge thread demanding it reconcile two of its own stances; like a willow it may bend with new evidence but must not snap into contradiction without explanation. A sybil farm cannot keep dozens of identities positionally coherent under adversarial challenge without doing the real reasoning per identity — the very cost it tries to dodge.
